pr817.title: fix(system2-data): reconcile exact Daily Shadow symbol sessions

rootCause.defect: A missing expected recent eligible symbol-session can be silently replaced by an older row while selectedDateCount still equals the required count.
rootCause.canonicalCounterexample: Expected D1..D60, D55 missing, D0 present -> count remains 60 but exact required session set is wrong.

bollinger.requirement: The exact 20 eligible symbol-sessions must match the expected certified set. Twenty observed rows are insufficient when one required recent session is missing and an older row substitutes.
bollinger.rejectionExample: 19 correct recent eligible sessions + 1 older substitute = REJECT even though rowCount=20.
bollinger.lifecycleHandling: Certified official no-trading sessions are excluded from the expected set before exact-set reconciliation; no synthetic close carry-forward.

adx.requirement: The ordered H/L/C recursion chain must match the exact expected eligible session sequence. A missing recent session plus older replacement invalidates recursive lineage even if count and final ADX value look plausible.
adx.rejectionExample: One missing eligible session changes TR/DM smoothing ancestry; an older bar cannot repair the chain.
adx.lifecycleHandling: Official non-trading intervals do not generate TR/DM rows. Resume/restart or transformed continuity remains separately certified.

directTrendMomentum.requirement: MA/retN/persistence windows must be exact eligible-session suffixes, not merely N latest observed rows.

requiredBeforePhysicalCredit: at least one real TWSE witness with exact expected/observed session hashes
positive lifecycle evidence only where applicable
